displayName: OCI-MOB-010: Mobile — Screenshot and Screen Recording Detection
description:
Detects screen capture or recording while sensitive content is displayed on mobile devices

⚠️ NEEDS-REWRITE: Query is generic SQL, needs conversion to Cloud Guard detector condition

conditions.value: mobile — screenshot and screen recording detection

dataSourceDetails.query: SELECT "siem_general_mob_010", "data__json.message" FROM "oci_monitoring_metricexplorer_metrics" WHERE "compartmentId" = '$COMPARTMENT_ID' AND "namespace" = 'OciLoggingService' AND ("data__json.message" LIKE '%mobile%' OR "data__json.message" LIKE '%screenshot%') AND "value" > 0
dataSourceDetails.originalQuery: SELECT "siem_general_mob_010", "data__json.message" FROM "oci_monitoring_metricexplorer_metrics" WHERE "compartmentId" = '$COMPARTMENT_ID' AND "namespace" = 'OciLoggingService' AND ("data__json.message" LIKE '%mobile%' OR "data__json.message" LIKE '%screenshot%') AND "value" > 0
